outputs.disclosure_statement: I used ChatGPT (GPT-4o) on October 28, 2026 to brainstorm possible explanations for lower soil moisture under rye for this assignment. On November 6 I used Claude (Claude Sonnet 4.6) to edit the discussion section, where the AI rewrote paragraphs; a few lines of AI-generated text appear in the final submission, and I edited that text before keeping it. I accepted about half of the suggested cuts and rewrote the rest myself. The November 6 session was recorded inside Claude; the October 28 details are from my own notes.
